free_parameters.name: num_q_heads
free_parameters.why: head count is not in the witness; the target condition only reads q.shape[1] (sequence length)

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: head count is not in the witness; the target condition only reads k.shape[1] (sequence length)

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: must be in {16,32,64,128} to pass the assertion immediately after the target on the negative run

free_parameters.name: gamma
free_parameters.why: required positional argument of the entry point; not read before the target assertion

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU-only harness has no bfloat16 GPU kernels; dtype cannot change a shape comparison

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixes tensor values so repeats are byte-identical; values cannot change a shape comparison

free_parameters.name: torch_threads
free_parameters.why: single-threaded execution keeps the run deterministic, as required by T6/D8

mocks.reason: on this no-GPU machine flash_attn_func aliases the triton kernel launcher; the negative run reaches it only after the target assert, so a CPU tensor stand-in lets that run return instead of crashing
